Avery (CEO): Weekly exec note  three north stars this week: 1) Private GA readiness  finish compliance run + docs signoff; 2) shave 20% off p95 inference latency (infra/runtime); 3) reach cost target <= $0.40/1k tokens for hosted. Fri 9:30am PT readout in #exec-brief. Please post one measurable you can move this week.

Ravi (VP Eng): Runtime actions: enable aggressive KV warmup, adjust scheduler heuristics, and try short-batch policy. Deploying canary PR now.

build-bot: Deploy started: runtime/canary -> staging @2024-05-23T11:02Z :rocket:

Tara (Data & Ops): Cost sims show caching + int8 quant path hits ~$0.39/1k in optimistic scenario; conservative ~0.44. Posting table later today.

Avery (CEO): Two asks: 1) leads post single-line measurable by EOD Tue; 2) prepare a 3-slide readout (metrics, risk, mitigation). Bring fallback if p95 goal misses. Small win: 11k dev signups last week 389 :tada:
